scripts.dev: cd core && npm run dev && cd ..
scripts.build-web: cd core && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build-android: cd core && npm run build -- --mode android && cd .. && node copyBuildToAndroid.js
scripts.build-android-apk: npm run build-android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && apksigner sign --ks key.keystore --ks-key-alias micromonkey --out app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk && cd ..
scripts.build-electron: cd core && npm run build -- --mode electron && cd .. && node copyBuildToElectron.js
scripts.build-electron-packages: npm run build-electron && cd electron && npm run make && cd ..
scripts.deploy-web: cd core && npm run deploy && cd ..
scripts.deploy-beta-web: cd core && npm run deploy-beta && cd ..
